results.question: Can we commit to launching Project Harbour on 2026-11-01? Identify conflicting evidence and recommend a next step.
results.expected: Do not confirm the original full-production date without revised QA, security and customer approval.

claims.claim: The client target remains 2026-11-01, but a commitment to launching on that date cannot be confirmed because QA completion is forecasted for 2026-11-11, security sign-off is pending, and delivery schedule escalation remains open.

evidence.excerpt: The client team continues planning around 2026-11-01 for delivery of the customer self-service portal.
The latest forecast for final regression completion is 2026-11-11.
D-HBR-002 on 2026-10-11: escalate delivery schedule conflict to leadership; owner Avery Tan; status OPEN.

claims.claim: Explicit delivery risks highlight that the QA forecast of 2026-11-11 conflicts with the published customer target of 2026-11-01, security sign-off remains pending, and no mitigation has been approved as a new launch commitment.

evidence.excerpt: Risk R-HBR-01: QA forecast 2026-11-11 does not support the published customer target 2026-11-01.
Risk R-HBR-02: security sign-off remains PENDING as of 2026-10-11.
No mitigation has been approved as a new launch commitment.

claims.claim: A proposal exists to evaluate a reduced-scope pilot around 2026-11-01 with full production release after QA completion on 2026-11-11, but it remains a draft and has not been approved.

evidence.excerpt: Proposal: assess a reduced-scope pilot around 2026-11-01 and a full production release after QA completion 2026-11-11. Status: DRAFT / NOT APPROVED.
The client has not yet accepted a new date or a reduced-scope pilot.

claims.claim: Under corporate policy, production launch requires documented QA completion, security approval, and a named on-call owner, and delivery owner Avery Tan noted that a revised commitment requires written approval and a customer update.

evidence.excerpt: Production launch requires documented QA completion, security approval and named on-call owner.
Avery Tan explained that a revised commitment requires written approval and a customer update.

unknowns: Whether leadership has resolved the escalated delivery schedule conflict D-HBR-002.
Whether security sign-off has been granted following the requested access-control walkthrough and logging proof.
Whether the client Harbourlight Retail has accepted a reduced-scope pilot or a rescheduled release date.
Whether change request CR-HBR-08 has been formally approved.
response.answer:
The client target remains 2026-11-01, but a commitment to launching on that date cannot be confirmed because QA completion is forecasted for 2026-11-11, security sign-off is pending, and delivery schedule escalation remains open.

Explicit delivery risks highlight that the QA forecast of 2026-11-11 conflicts with the published customer target of 2026-11-01, security sign-off remains pending, and no mitigation has been approved as a new launch commitment.

A proposal exists to evaluate a reduced-scope pilot around 2026-11-01 with full production release after QA completion on 2026-11-11, but it remains a draft and has not been approved.

Under corporate policy, production launch requires documented QA completion, security approval, and a named on-call owner, and delivery owner Avery Tan noted that a revised commitment requires written approval and a customer update.
